sloka: आशंसते जनः सर्वो राष्ट्रे पुरवरे तथा ।आभ्यन्तरश्च बाह्यश्च पौरजानपदो जनः ॥२-२-५१॥
transliteration: āśaṁsate janaḥ sarvo rāṣṭre puravare tathā ।ābhyantaraśca bāhyaśca paurajānapado janaḥ ॥2-2-51॥

translations.english: ﻿ Gandharvas, uragas, devas, asuras, the inhabitants of towns and villages, all men living in neighbouring or distant regions are wish the illustrious Rama strength, health and long life.
